title: Measure error
description: Error body from every path on this service: POST /measure, POST /upload, POST /screen, POST /scan, and the statuses raised before any view runs. Frozen by TICK-224 so TICK-063 can code against failure as well as success. HTTP status is not a field in the body; on /measure it is paired with this shape as follows: 400 — the request is missing a required part or the sidecar is not JSON; 422 — the sidecar is JSON but fails capture_sidecar.schema.json. This SUPERSEDES TICK-060 AC4, which specified 400 for a schema-invalid sidecar; 422 distinguishes a well-formed request carrying bad content from a malformed request, which TICK-063 needs in order to tell the operator whether to re-capture or re-send. The enum grows by APPENDING: TICK-063's MeasureClient decodes this shape and hangs its operator advice off the token, so an unrecognised token decodes to nil there, and respelling one silently changes what a phone tells the operator standing at an entrance. TICK-225 (#113) landed: every response from this service now carries this shape, including statuses raised before any view runs — 404 (unknown path), 405 (wrong method), 413 (body too large), 415 (unsupported content type) and 500 (unhandled exception). Those are registered as one general handler rather than per-status cases, so a status nobody anticipated cannot slip back to HTML. TICK-264 (#264) made the enum as wide as that scope. It listed only /measure's tokens and the framework's, so every error /upload and /screen returned failed the contract that claimed to describe it, and their statuses — 401, 403, 409, 502, 503 — went undocumented with them. The enum below is grouped by the path that emits a token, /measure first, and a token two paths share is listed once. tests/test_error_schema_covers_the_service.py derives the emitted set from the view sources and fails on any token this enum does not allow, so the two cannot drift apart again.

enum: entrance_id is not a canonical entrance id
sha256 is not a hex digest
could not build a storage key
an object is already stored under this capture id
a different object is already stored under this capture id
stored object could not be read back
stored object does not match its hash
error.description: Stable class of failure. TICK-063 branches on this token, not on detail wording.

detail.description: Human-readable specifics, truncated to 256 characters so a rejected sidecar cannot inflate the response. Never the raw rejected input. Constrained by pattern rather than minLength because a whitespace-only string satisfies minLength and still renders as a blank, which is the same hole that was closed on the sidecar patterns in TICK-228 and TICK-229.

field.description: JSONPath of the offending sidecar field when validation failed. Absent when the failure is not a field error.

latency_ms.description: Elapsed model-attempt time in milliseconds. Present on screening-engine responses after a model call was attempted; absent on failures rejected before that boundary.
